steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge PBA terminals per manual.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the power plug before servicing.

steps.title: Door fully closed
steps.body: Ensure lower door closed with no laundry caught. During Boil cycle, pressure may trigger false DC — verify door seal.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Ensure lower door closed with no laundry caught. During Boil cycle, pressure may trigger false DC — verify door seal.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Close door and clear debris from lock tray.

steps.title: Reed switch (White–Green)
steps.body: Approx 0.2 Ω at reed switch in door-closed state.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Approx 0.2 Ω at reed switch in door-closed state.

steps.title: Lock motor (Black–Brown)
steps.body: 34–51 Ω at lock motor in lock/unlock state.
steps.sourceExcerpt: 34–51 Ω at lock motor in lock/unlock state.

steps.title: Lock/unlock contacts
steps.body: Lock White–Red and Unlock White–Blue — approx 0.2 Ω in each state.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Lock White–Red and Unlock White–Blue — approx 0.2 Ω in each state.

steps.title: Continue to manual check
steps.body: Smart Install active. Continue below for component-specific checks.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Manual check mode — Delay End advances steps per §4-2.

steps.title: Door circuit OK
steps.oemOutcome: Lower door lock circuit verified — inspect main PBA if code persists.
